evidence: git grep -n -i 'numbered (question' -> plugins/openspec/skills/spec-review/SKILL.md:34:the rest as numbered questions with lettered options, your recommendation
failing_case: The front runs openspec:spec-review and reaches step 2 "Questions first": the skill says "Ask the rest as numbered
questions with lettered options". The owner gets "1. ... 2. ..." again, the opposite of his 28 Oct word
"откажемся от нумерации". Should say: each question opens with a bold title, not numbered, options lettered.

reason: tests/test_no_numbers_texts.py:14 and :21; spec-review SKILL.md step 2 now says bold title, no number, lettered options; fails at base.
